product_goal: Help an individual or team turn approved evidence into a bounded decision, reviewed action, exact receipt, and maintained reusable knowledge.

layers.name: Case authority and scope
layers.purpose: Bind the objective, decision, authority, risks, done conditions, reviewer, and stop rules before retrieval.

layers.name: Approved source spine
layers.purpose: Admit exact current public sources and exclude unlisted, private, identifying, or credential-bearing material.

layers.name: Bounded context perception
layers.purpose: Combine controlled context, deterministic lexical retrieval, exact reads, contradictions, and gaps into one source-visible capsule.

layers.name: Adaptive role crew
layers.purpose: Select the smallest responsible role pack and bind each role to one output, capability ceiling, reviewer, and handoff.

layers.name: Specialist research and delivery
layers.purpose: Produce a source-linked candidate without expanding authority or representing a draft as an action.

layers.name: State control, validation, and review
layers.purpose: Apply state transitions, attempt caps, deterministic checks, repair routes, interrupts, verification, and independent review.

layers.name: Receipts, outcomes, and maintained knowledge
layers.purpose: Record exact results and readback, then promote only reviewed reusable meaning with lineage, freshness, and supersession.

langgraph.role: optional state-machine runtime for the canonical transitions

crewai.role: optional materialization of the selected role and task contracts

llamaindex.role: optional framework import around the exact-manifest retrieval contract

dashboard_distribution.job: Explain the problem, loop, boundaries, and four schemas.
Prepare one bounded case and review packet.
Select functional contracts and portable packages.
Separate zero-key core from optional gated integrations.
Show fixtures, exact comparators, limitations, verdicts, and receipts.
Review and consume one Jarvis handoff without URL payloads.
